title: Lock the core API runtimes and remove obsolete SSE/Pydantic/dependency branches
summary: Locked the core API and service runtimes against official PyPI latest stable releases under Python 3.12. Established root constraints at dependencies/constraints-core.txt and generated all 28 service and root-test lockfiles under dependencies/locks/. Wired all 24+ in-scope runtime Dockerfiles to install from their locked dependency closures (dependencies/locks/<service>.txt). Reconciled google-cloud-storage to official PyPI latest stable 3.14.1 across constraints and locks. Aligned services/search/Dockerfile base image to python:3.12-slim to satisfy numpy==2.5.2 and verified clean container build. Reconciled services/search/requirements.lock pins (psycopg==3.3.6, psycopg-binary==3.3.6, uvicorn==0.53.0) with dependencies/constraints-core.txt. Added pytest>=8.0.0,<10.0.0 to monorepo root requirements.txt and regenerated dependencies/locks/root-tests.txt, restoring CI owner contract runs. Restored production assertion semantics in services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_ppl_alloc_009_assertion_semantics.py by removing injected monkeypatches and exercising main._pm12_semantic_values_match. Completed native FastAPI SSE integration: retired injected fallback handle_sse_stream preference in events/router.py, wired EventStreamService to handle event_filter and [DONE] token termination natively so mounted application endpoints return EventSourceResponse without modifying main.py. Bound EventStreamService data_dir to dynamic fallback across PANTHEON_BFF_DATA_DIR, BFF_DATA_DIR, and /tmp/pantheon/bff, aligning reader with main publisher file-backed replay and restart. Applied jsonable_encoder in events/service.py publish() and _append_shared_event() serialization boundary to prevent datetime/enum/null/fingerprint serialization errors; added real file-backed persistence and reload tests for EventStreamService and ConsultationStore, mounted-app replay/restart regression test with BFF_DATA_DIR, plus actual adapter HTTP [DONE] transport termination in test_pkt005_sse_substrate_contract.py. Synchronized .venv-pantheon with exact locked closures (cryptography 50.0.1, jsonschema 4.26.0, blinker 1.9.0, jinja2 3.1.6, markupsafe 3.0.3, google-cloud-storage 3.14.1). Verified with 443 passed tests across consultation, openclaw adapter, SSE contracts, auth/assertion, and search suites with zero skips.

candidate_4_disposition.description: Native SSE and one Pydantic-v2 API baseline

pydantic_v1_removals.details: Removed fallback branches to .dict() and model_dump(mode='json') wrapping; replaced with native Pydantic v2 model_dump(mode='json'), model_dump_json(), and model_copy(deep=True). Preserved generic dict/dataclass serialization.
Removed .dict() calls in _actor_to_data and _request_dict. Replaced __fields__ traversal in _stored_create_fingerprint with model_fields iteration for Pydantic v2.
Removed hasattr(obj, 'dict') branch in _model_dict; standardized on model_dump(mode='json').

native_sse_migration.details: Migrated from custom SSE framing to fastapi.sse.EventSourceResponse and fastapi.sse.format_sse_event. Applied jsonable_encoder to publish() and _append_shared_event() serialization boundary to prevent datetime/enum/null/fingerprint serialization errors. Enhanced stream() with native event_filter and [DONE] termination support, preserving heartbeat comment framing. Bound data_dir to dynamically respect PANTHEON_BFF_DATA_DIR or BFF_DATA_DIR or /tmp/pantheon/bff so reader and publisher share the same file replay directory when only BFF_DATA_DIR is configured.

Removed obsolete fallback dispatchers _default_sse_stream and retired fallback handle_sse_stream preference. Stream endpoints invoke EventStreamService and EventSourceResponse directly with event_filter and [DONE] support, ensuring mounted application endpoints return EventSourceResponse without modifying main.py. Wired create_events_router to accept data_dir and expose router.event_stream_service.
Migrated invoke_openclaw_provider_stream to fastapi.sse.EventSourceResponse and fastapi.sse.format_sse_event.

Added comprehensive native SSE acceptance fixtures proving multiline data, exact event IDs, disconnect cancellation, persisted date-enum-null/fingerprint serialization with disk file persistence and reload, actual adapter HTTP [DONE] transport termination, and mounted-app replay and restart with BFF_DATA_DIR.
Updated router stream test to verify native EventStreamService via client.stream rather than injected fallback handler.

candidate_12_disposition.description: Unused dependencies, locks and complete OSS family upgrades - Core runtime baseline

runtime_dependency_cleanups.changes: Removed python-jose[cryptography], passlib[bcrypt], and pytest; added cryptography>=50.0.1 and google-cloud-storage>=2.16,<4.0.
Added pytest>=8.0.0,<10.0.0 to root monorepo test closure to support CI jobs without modifying workflow files.
Reconciled psycopg==3.3.6, psycopg-binary==3.3.6, and uvicorn==0.53.0 with dependencies/constraints-core.txt.

dockerfile_reconciliations.changes: Updated base image to python:3.12-slim to satisfy numpy==2.5.2 requirement in requirements.lock; verified clean container build.
Pinned exact versions matching core baseline.
Retained existing pinned versions as required by SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001 soak window.
Wired all 24+ in-scope runtime Dockerfiles to copy and install from their exact locked closures (dependencies/locks/<service>.txt).

review_decision.note: Independently verify against this exact head: (1) native SSE migration on production BFF path with retired injected fallback handle_sse_stream preference in events/router.py, native event_filter/[DONE] termination in EventStreamService, and reader binding to BFF_DATA_DIR for file-backed replay/restart without modifying main.py; (2) persistence and DONE token evidence with jsonable_encoder serialization in events/service.py, real file-backed persistence and reload tests for EventStreamService and ConsultationStore, mounted-app replay/restart regression test with BFF_DATA_DIR, and actual adapter HTTP [DONE] transport termination; (3) search API baseline reconciliation with psycopg==3.3.6, psycopg-binary==3.3.6, and uvicorn==0.53.0 in services/search/requirements.lock aligned with constraints-core.txt; (4) services/search/Dockerfile aligned with python:3.12-slim; (5) all 24+ service Dockerfiles wired to install exact locked closures from dependencies/locks/*.txt; (6) google-cloud-storage reconciled to official PyPI latest stable 3.14.1 across constraints, locks, and venv; (7) pytest moved to root requirements.txt for CI owner contract runs; (8) test_ppl_alloc_009_assertion_semantics exercises real production authority main._pm12_semantic_values_match; (9) all 443 tests pass cleanly with zero skips.
